messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 INCIDENT: northbridge-vpc gateway streaming errors detected for tenant nbf-001. Auto-page sent to oncall. Service: enterprise-gateway (vpc).

oncall-alex: I'm on it. Can someone pick up initial triage? Seeing a spike in WS close codes (1006) and 502 from gateway.

sre-priya: I'll take triage. Alex, can you pull the gateway logs for nbf-001 and the dedicated pool mapping (dedicated-eu-3)? I want to see connection durations and retry patterns.

infra-miguel: Pulling logs now, tailing proxy frontends. Quick note: burst of CONNECT followed by exponential backoff retries from customer IPs around 12:03 UTC.

eng-ml-janet: Customer reported increased response latency before disconnects. They use streaming for live inference and aggressive client retry with no jitter.

support-sam: Nathan (Northbridge NOC) is on the line and confirmed they rolled a client-side change ~11:58 that increased concurrency per session. He says it started ~12:02 and affects ~20% of their sessions.

customer-noc-nathan: Confirmed. We deployed a deploy that raised stream concurrency per user. Rolling back now but need plan if we need to throttle from your side.

incident-bot: Current status: degraded streaming for tenant nbf-001. Impact: client timeouts, partial request failures, customers seeing reconnect loops. Pager escalations sent.

sre-priya: Initial findings: gateway is hitting connection handling limits on dedicated-eu-3. Kernel syn backlog and proxy worker saturation. Also notice continuous retries causing resource starvation and tail latencies for other tenants in same pool.

oncall-alex: Action items: 1) Enable per-tenant connection cap on edge for nbf-001, 2) Temporarily route nbf-001 to backup pool (dedicated-eu-4), 3) Ask customer to gate retries with jitter and backoff. Who can push route?

infra-miguel: I can push a routing change. Preparing a test patch to route a subset of traffic (10%) to dedicated-eu-4 first. Command I will run: ```sh
rbw route set --tenant nbf-001 --to dedicated-eu-4 --weight 10
```

sre-priya: Good. Also enable quick per-tenant connection reject threshold so we don't let the tenant take down the pool: ```yaml
tenant_limits:
  nbf-001:
    max_conns: 1200
    conn_rate_limit: 400/s
```
Please stage that config to edge-ctrl.

infra-miguel: Staged connection caps and routing patch in canary. Pushing to 10% now.

incident-bot: Change deployed to canary (10%). Observability note: initial canary shows error rate for nbf-001 down by ~30% on canaried sessions. Overall pool error rate unchanged yet.

support-sam: Nathan, can you validate that users on the canaried path show improved stability?

customer-noc-nathan: Confirmed: sessions routed to the backup pool remain stable. The ones still on EU-3 are still flapping. Rolling back client change as well.

sre-liaison: Recommend immediate action: increase routing weight to 100% to failover nbf-001 to dedicated-eu-4 and block further new connections to EU-3 from that tenant. This avoids noisy neighbor impact. Any objections?

oncall-alex: No objections. Proceed. Miguel, execute full failover and apply connection caps on EU-3 to prevent reconnections.

infra-miguel: Executing full traffic shift now: ```sh
rbw route set --tenant nbf-001 --to dedicated-eu-4 --weight 100 --reason "mitigate streaming storm"
rbw edge-config apply --file staged-nbf-caps.yaml
```

incident-bot: Full failover completed at 12:17 UTC. Post-failover metrics: request error rate for nbf-001 dropped from 18% -> 1.2% over 5m. Pool CPU on EU-3 dropped by 38%.

eng-ml-janet: ML inference runtimes on EU-4 look healthy; no model aversions triggered. We should verify cache priming if there are cold starts.

sre-priya: Next steps: 1) Keep failover in place until root cause identified and customer back on safe retry behavior; 2) Collect full logs (conn traces, proxy metrics) for RCA; 3) Run a targeted rate-test to validate EU-3 capacity after rollback.

support-sam: Notifying Northbridge account team and scheduling customer postmortem call. Nathan, we'll need your client retry policy and exact deploy diffs for RCA.

customer-noc-nathan: Will share deploy diff and config now. Appreciate the quick failover.

infra-miguel: Saving incident runbook entry and tags: [tenant:nbf-001] [mitigation:failover] [root_cause_investigation:pending].

sre-priya: Quick mitigation note for runbook: when tenant causes pool saturation due to retry storm, do immediate per-tenant failover to backup pool and apply connection caps at edge. Avoid full pool restart while customers are live.

oncall-alex: Handoff: I'm going offline for sprint planning in 20m. Priya will take primary on the postmortem/RCA. Priya, please ack.

sre-priya: Ack — I'll own follow-ups and RCA timeline. I'll coordinate with eng-ml for model warmup verification and support for customer-facing timeline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> streaming stable for nbf-001 (post-failover). Paging cleared.

support-sam: Creating ticket INC-237654 for customer comms and RCA deliverable. ETA for initial RCA draft: 24 hours.

eng-ml-janet: Suggest adding a new automated check in preflight for high-concurrency client changes for streaming clients. Could reduce recurrence.

sre-priya: Agreed. Adding to action items: preflight check + per-tenant throttles + docs for customer retry best-practices.

customer-noc-nathan: Thanks team. We'll wait for RCA. We'll keep the client change rolled back for now.

oncall-alex: Thanks everyone. Leaving the channel to the RCA owners. :white_check_mark:
